items.text: The current look-and-feel and usability of remote controls are disliked by users and are hard to learn, with remotes often getting lost in rooms.
items.selection_reason: From observed dialogue, these UX and ergonomic pain points drive remapping and redesign of the remote UI.

items.text: Uncertainty about saving the project file (whether it saves automatically and where).

items.text: The target group will be sixteen to forty.

items.text: The basic new requirements of the management were no teletext, only for T_V_.

items.text: Teletext and the newsflash feature will not be used in the future.
items.selection_reason: Related teletext decision; duplicate reference.

items.text: Keep all classic remote functions and improve button usability and the physical design.
items.selection_reason: Preserve core capabilities while improving UX.

items.text: The product must include corporate identity with the logo present and colours consistent.

items.text: The PM will write the meeting minutes.
